summary: Design hybrid operating rhythms, decision protocols and inclusion practices. Build a practical roadmap for distributed teams. Explore the course.
lede: Hybrid work design helps senior leaders and people teams create practical ways for distributed teams to coordinate, make decisions and support fair, healthy working practices. Participants assess current arrangements, map collaboration needs and decision ownership, set asynchronous working norms, and develop wellbeing and inclusion checks for a phased operating-model plan.
audienceIntro: This programme is designed for leaders and specialists who shape how distributed teams coordinate work, make decisions and sustain fair, healthy working practices.
prerequisites: Prior experience leading a function, advising on people or organizational change, or shaping workforce practices is recommended. No coding or programming is required. A laptop and access to Excel are useful for developing and reviewing course artefacts.
